subject.title: [Feature]: Allow telegram groups by creating allowList of users

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled Telegram `groupPolicy: "members"` mode, and what fail-closed all-current-members contract should it enforce?
rationale: The request changes who can trigger agents from Telegram groups and introduces a new config/security boundary that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve fail-closed members policy
options.body: Implement a Telegram-only policy that verifies all current group members against trusted numeric IDs and blocks on uncertain membership checks.

options.title: Keep explicit group allowlists
options.body: Decline the bundled policy for now and keep users on explicit Telegram group IDs or community plugin workarounds.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed members policy
recommendation.body: Implement a Telegram-only policy that verifies all current group members against trusted numeric IDs and blocks on uncertain membership checks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the most detailed maintainer-facing review of this security/config boundary and is the clearest routing candidate from the issue history.
